And these are; the chiefs of the houses of their families. The sons of Reuben first-born of Israel -- Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi -- this is the kin of Reuben.
And the sons of Simeon -- Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul the one; from the Phoenician woman. These are; the families of the sons of Simeon.
And these are; the names of the sons of Levi according to their kin -- Gershon, Kohath and Merari; and the years of the life of Levi -- a hundred thirty-seven years.
And these are; the sons of Gershon -- Libni and Shimei; the houses of their family.
And the sons of Kohath -- Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel; and the years of the life of Kohath -- a hundred thirty years.
And the sons of Merari -- Mahli, and Mushi. These are; the houses of the families of Levi, according to their kin.

And Amram took ; Jochebed daughter of the brother ; of his father to himself for a wife. And she bore to him ; also Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam ; their sister. And the years of the life of Amram -- a hundred thirty-seven years.
And the sons of Izhar -- Korah, and Nepheg, and Zithri.
And the sons of Uzziel -- Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Zithri.

These are the ones reasoning with Pharaoh king of Egypt, so as to lead the sons of Israel from out of Egypt -- Aaron himself and Moses,
in the day the LORD spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.
